description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): List human-owned product capabilities, rebuild one current capability map, or compare it across exact Git refs from .fixmap/capabilities.json. With action create, update, or remove it writes .fixmap/capabilities.json through the same locked, atomic, symlink-refusing path as fixmap capability; use an action only when the user asks for that change. The store contains explicit names, anchors, and bounds only; no generated conclusions, API, LLM, semantic inference, or account.

action.description: Change the store; omit to read

add.description: Planned path anchors; missing paths stay unresolved (create/update)

from.description: Earlier exact Git ref; requires id and to

id.description: Capability id to show or change; omit to list definitions

repo.description: Local checkout path (defaults to the MCP server repository)

repository.description: Store repository identity when creating the first capability

to.description: Later exact Git ref; requires id and from

workspace.description: Store workspace identity when creating the first capability

name: fixmap_capability
title: FixMap capability
